recommendation: Keep the FHIR-46701 audit commit as-is. Do not make additional FHIR-core changes for this seed; handle any future THO migration or canonical redirect cleanup under the later terminology trackers.
issue_request: FHIR-46701 was Applied with Persuasive with Modification resolution for R6. It requested replacing the inappropriate NutritionIntake.statusReason example binding to clinicalimpression-status-reason with a NutritionIntake-specific example value set containing patient factors, and revising NutritionIntake.performer wording using the event performer pattern for performer, function, and actor.
initial_application: Commit 05e646d74bb93a1c435d884747dc64da94898435 changed the NutritionIntake performer branch to use 'Who or what performed the intake' wording and 'Type of performance'. Commit a7259ce6c19569a3bd8cc7fc7c788755c10f9ab4 created the NutritionIntake status-reason CodeSystem and ValueSet and changed NutritionIntake.statusReason to bind to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/nutritionintake-status-reason.
additional_context: NutritionIntake is active in source/fhir.ini. OO minutes for 2025-01-15 confirm the FHIR-46701 6-0-0 motion and implementation shape: create value sets and model the performer/actor branch from the event resource pattern. Later Applied FHIR-53303 refined the same statusReason terminology by replacing inactive SNOMED CT Patient Died with Dead 419099009, removing Entered in Error, and replacing numeric local codes with mnemonic codes. Later Applied FHIR-55266 deliberately made the CodeSystem and ValueSet experimental while THO migration remains unsettled.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. Current source already has NutritionIntake.statusReason bound to the NutritionIntake status-reason value set, revised performer/function/actor wording, and the current later-refined statusReason terminology. Adding older example concepts such as ethical/religious under FHIR-46701 would conflict with the more recent applied terminology trail rather than fix the current spec.
